decisions.reason: The drawing-numbering convention does not change the requirement to deliver 3D CAD models or their accepted file formats.
Numbering drawings according to the assembly does not change the accuracy or inclusion of dimension annotations.
The source adds a presentation convention captured by the source Requirement but does not change the obligation to provide the manufacturing drawing set.

The drawing-numbering clause does not alter the bushing location, clearance fit, piston-rod arrangement, or sliding-end connection. Other clauses in the same message are already represented separately and are not effects of the source numbering decision.

The drawing-numbering convention does not change the welded assembly geometry or fabrication sequence. The fabrication clause in the same message is a separate decision already represented in this candidate's history.
